top.en: I'm giving you 5 stars, not because you played well, but because you really have it rough. To put it bluntly, while normal people decline a position three times before accepting, you push your way in three times. Back on 100T you were doing fine as an assistant coach, until their top laner Sniper got his mental broken, so they forced you in to play. Finding out you still had some juice in you, they just kept you as a player and didn't even buy anyone else. This year on Lyon you also applied for an assistant coach position, but then their starting top laner Zamudo failed his visa, so they dragged you out to play again. Realizing you actually still had juice, they just kicked Zamudo and kept making you play. During that period when your form dropped, oh, the team finally realized you're fundamentally an assistant coach and quickly signed a Korean top laner Castle, but after playing a few games looking like complete trash, they spedrun firing him too and put you back in. Have you ever seen an assistant coach who only sat in the coach's chair a few times? Anyway, it's my first time. Was this draft meant to blow yourselves up so management can see that you're genuinely old and can't carry anymore, saving you from being dragged back out to drain your remaining value [~0:1]? But honestly, when I watched the live streams before and saw you sitting in that assistant coach seat, you looked genuinely thrilled.

notes.context: Slang for relying on veterans or old players past their prime instead of developing new talent.
